12:13 AM

Every weekday at 8 AM tell me the weather in Delhi
12:13 AM

I can’t set up repeating checks yet. Ask me each time and I’ll do it then.

12:13 AM

Write a 4-line poem about monsoon in Mumbai
12:14 AM

Here's one for the rains:

Grey clouds roll in from the Arabian Sea,
Marine Drive wears a silver sheen.
Chai steams hot as the lanes run free,
And the whole city dances in the rain. 🌧️

12:14 AM
